summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes shipped obfuscated bundle
details: @onereach/orest-input-cli@1.18.1 declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, and uses it to execute `math_init.js` — a 727KB obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle shipped in the tarball. The setup.mjs loader itself uses obfuscator-style identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and string-property indirection to hide constants. The bundled payload begins with `// @bun @bun-cjs` and contains a string-array rotation cipher (`WV8StW`, `n7gIxM`) that reconstructs strings at runtime, making its behavior unobservable to Node-based tooling. On any `npm install` of this package, arbitrary opaque code runs under an alternate runtime that bypasses Node-visible instrumentation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
